name: styk-mobile
description: Android wrapper (Capacitor) around the StykAnimate web build.

scripts.android:add: node scripts/preflight.mjs && node scripts/prepare-www.mjs && cap add android && node scripts/patch-android.mjs
scripts.android:sync: node scripts/preflight.mjs && node scripts/prepare-www.mjs && cap sync android && node scripts/patch-android.mjs
